integrity: Explicit proof, five orbit representatives and standalone exhaustive finite verifier included; numerical experiments do not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Standard zero forcing only, prisms with at least five rungs, and the first nonzero zero-forcing-polynomial coefficient only. Equivalent unindexed results are possible. Independent scientific review is not performed.
title: Five symmetry types and \(13n\) minimum zero forcing sets on circular ladders
